payload.claim: `_block1_lines` returns a distinct "case:" string for "no item cited" (line 2280) versus "item cited but no record" (line 2283), and acceptance criterion 1 requires the block to say "which of the two it met." But `test_bookkeeping_prints_three_blocks_and_the_specs_line_its_origin_item_owes` only asserts `case_205 != case_206` (test_spec_loop_driver.py:2689) — it never checks either string's actual content. Swapping the two return messages between the `item_id is None` branch and the `item is None` branch keeps both outputs distinct (so the test stays green) while making the printed case label say the wrong thing for both SA-0205 and SA-0206, which is exactly the acceptance criterion this test claims to cover.
